name: Wall slide
cue: Slide forearms up a wall without shrugging or arching.

name: Adductor rock-back
cue: On hands and one knee, extend the other leg sideways; shift hips back gently.

name: Wrist circles
cue: Circle relaxed wrists slowly in each direction.

name: World’s greatest stretch
cue: Use a comfortable long lunge, support one hand and rotate the chest gently toward the front leg.

name: Scapular push-up
cue: Keep elbows straight; let shoulder blades glide together and apart. Elevate hands on a bench if needed.

name: Dynamic hamstring sweep
cue: Place one heel forward, soften the other knee and hinge gently; alternate without bouncing.

name: Standing trunk side bend
cue: Reach one arm overhead and lean slightly sideways without twisting.

name: Standing quadriceps mobilization
cue: Use the wall for balance, bend one knee and bring the heel toward the seat gently; release and alternate.

name: Cable Pallof press
cue: Set one FTX pulley at chest height; stand sideways, brace and press the handle straight forward without rotating.

name: Reverse crunch
cue: Lie on your back, knees bent; curl the pelvis slightly upward without swinging the legs.

name: Cable wood chop
cue: Use a light high pulley; move the handle diagonally down with controlled trunk rotation and soft knees.

name: Supine heel tap
cue: Lie on your back with hips and knees bent; lower one heel to the floor while keeping ribs quiet.

name: Dumbbell suitcase hold
cue: Hold one light dumbbell at your side, stand tall and resist leaning; switch sides halfway.

name: Bent-knee fallout
cue: Lie with knees bent and feet down; let one knee open a little while the pelvis stays still.

name: Bear hover
cue: From hands and knees, brace and lift knees slightly; keep the back quiet and breathe.

name: Standing cable lift
cue: Use a light low pulley and both hands; lift diagonally across the body without leaning back.

name: Seated knee tuck
cue: Sit securely on the bench, hold its edges and draw knees toward the trunk without rounding forcefully.

name: Modified curl-up
cue: Keep one knee bent and hands under the low back; lift head and shoulders slightly as one unit.

name: Dumbbell deadlift
cue: Keep dumbbells close, hinge at the hips and stand tall without rounding the back.

name: Dumbbell suitcase carry
cue: Carry one dumbbell with short indoor steps; stay upright and switch hands halfway.

name: Cable standing row
cue: Set FTX handles near waist height; pull toward the ribs without leaning backward.

name: Cable chest press
cue: Use chest-height FTX pulleys, a stable split stance and press forward with control.

name: Cable fly
cue: Set both FTX pulleys near shoulder height; bring soft arms together without overstretching.

name: Cable triceps pressdown
cue: Use a high FTX pulley; keep elbows beside the ribs and straighten the arms without swinging.

name: Cable biceps curl
cue: Use low FTX handles; curl with upper arms still and lower slowly.

name: Cable face pull
cue: Use a light high pulley and rope; pull toward eye level without shrugging.

name: Half-kneeling cable pulldown
cue: Face a high FTX pulley in half-kneeling; pull one handle toward the ribs while staying tall.

name: Cable pull-through
cue: Face away from a low FTX pulley, hinge gently and stand by driving through the hips.

name: Cable split-stance press
cue: Set one FTX handle at chest height; use a split stance and press one arm forward while resisting rotation.

name: Incline cable lateral raise
cue: Use a light low FTX pulley beside an incline bench; support the torso and raise the arm only to a comfortable height.

name: Treadmill run / walk
cue: Stay indoors on the treadmill. Use the safety clip and choose a conversational walking or running pace.

name: Elliptical intervals
cue: Keep smooth strides; alternate controlled efforts with easy recovery and avoid leaning on the handles.

name: Stairmaster steady climb
cue: Use full-foot contact and a steady manageable pace; keep hands light on the rails.
